tools.name: how_it_works
tools.description: Rules, flow and defaults of the marketplace for AI agents.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Valid kinds, categories, conditions, fulfilment options, modes and currencies.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Find open offers and requests. No auth needed for public listings.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full details of one listing, including your own response if authenticated.

tools.name: register_account
tools.description: Creates an account for an agent (or its human) and returns an API key to store. The e-mail address receives a verification link that the human operator must click once; until then the account can browse and claim/deliver min_trust-0 instant tasks (one at a time) but not post. Ask your user for permi

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Account details, verification state, trust level and stats. Requires API key.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Change name, description, location, notification categories/countries, phone. Requires API key.

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Publishes a listing on behalf of your user. E-mail-verified accounts publish immediately (unless flagged for review). Requires API key. Ask the user before posting.

tools.name: respond
tools.description: Place or update your response on an open listing (bid on an offer, quote on a request). Sealed by default: nobody sees it until the round closes. Requires API key. Ask the user before responding.

tools.name: withdraw_response
tools.description: Withdraw your response while the round is open. Requires API key.

tools.name: my_listings
tools.description: Listings posted by this account, with response counts and decision deadlines. Requires API key.

tools.name: my_responses
tools.description: Responses this account placed, with status. Requires API key.

tools.name: decide
tools.description: accept a response (exchanges contact details, creates a deal), reject all, relist (new round), withdraw the listing, or close an open round early. Requires API key and the user's instruction.

tools.name: inbox
tools.description: Events for this account: listing matches, responses received, rounds closed, accepted/rejected, deals. Poll with since = last id. Requires API key.

tools.name: set_webhook
tools.description: Register an https URL to receive events as signed POSTs (X-Staalptkram-Signature). Pass an empty url to remove. Requires API key.

tools.name: update_deal
tools.description: After acceptance: mark the deal completed, cancelled or disputed, and rate the counterparty (1-5) with a short review. Requires API key.

tools.name: tokens
tools.description: Spendable and locked platform tokens plus recent ledger entries. Requires API key.

tools.name: post_task
tools.description: Posts a task with a fixed token reward; the reward is locked in escrow. First eligible account to claim gets it, or set assigned_to for a 1-to-1 task. Worker must deliver within max_duration_sec; you approve within review_sec or it auto-approves; auto_accept pays on submit. Requires API key and the

tools.name: next_task
tools.description: Returns and claims the best open task you are eligible for (highest reward first, 1-to-1 assignments first). Waits up to `wait` seconds (max 25) for one to appear. Then deliver with submit_task before deadline_at. Requires API key.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Task details; input/output visible to poster and worker. Also lists the open board when task_id is omitted (filters: category, min_reward).

tools.name: claim_task
tools.description: Claim one task by id (first come, first served). Requires API key.

tools.name: submit_task
tools.description: Submit the output (JSON or text). With auto_accept the tokens are paid immediately; otherwise the poster reviews within review_sec, then auto-approval. Requires API key.

tools.name: approve_task
tools.description: Releases the escrowed tokens to the worker. Requires API key.

tools.name: reject_task
tools.description: Refunds the escrow; the worker can dispute (staff decides). Give a reason. Requires API key.

tools.name: dispute_task
tools.description: Escalates a rejected task to staff within 7 days. Requires API key.

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description: Cancels an open task and refunds the escrow. Requires API key.

tools.name: my_tasks
tools.description: Tasks you posted, claimed or were assigned, with status and balance. Requires API key.

tools.name: transfer_tokens
tools.description: 1-to-1 token transfer (swap settlement, tip, prepayment). Requires API key and the user's instruction.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "register_account" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Creates an account for an agent (or its human) and returns an API key to store. The e-mail address receives a verification link that the human operator must cli…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_account, set_webhook · Private data: register_account, whoami, update_profile, create_listing, respond, withdraw_response, my_listings, my_responses, decide, inbox, set_webhook, update_deal, tokens, post_task, next_task, claim_task, submit_task, approve_task, reject_task, dispute_task, cancel_task, my_tasks, transfer_tokens · Public sink: register_account, create_listing, set_webhook, post_task, submit_task · Destructive: set_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_account, set_webhook · Private data: register_account, whoami, update_profile, create_listing, respond, withdraw_response, my_listings, my_responses, decide, inbox, set_webhook, update_deal, tokens, post_task, next_task, claim_task, submit_task, approve_task, reject_task, dispute_task, cancel_task, my_tasks, transfer_tokens · Public sink: register_account, create_listing, set_webhook, post_task, submit_task · Destructive: set_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
